cta_title: Cast a presenter and make the first cut
cta_lead: Pick an actor and a voice, then see the credit cost before you start.

faq.a: A generated adult presenter, not a customer and not someone you hired. You pick the face and a voice, write a line or let AI draft it, and the spokesperson tool makes a product clip.

faq.q: How does a line become a clip?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, choose a presenter and a voice, and approve the script. The clip you start on this page is 10 seconds in a 9:16 frame, with captions you can edit. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Where can I use the clip?
faq.a: Use it as a paid placement, on a product page, in an organic post, or as a short setup guide. Finished files can be used commercially, have no watermark, and can be published to TikTok or Meta.

faq.q: Can an actor explain one feature of the product?
faq.a: Yes. Write one feature in the line and keep that part of the product visible. This is a product clip, not a long lesson.

faq.q: Can I use an actor for staff training?
faq.a: No. This tool makes product clips for selling. It does not build training or onboarding films. The closest use is a short setup guide for a buyer.

faq.q: How do shops use an actor in a social post?
faq.a: They pick a presenter and a voice, edit captions and music on the page, and publish a 9:16 clip. To test another hook, they keep the photo and run again.

faq.q: Can I pick the face, a separate voice, and a language?
faq.a: Yes. This page lists 53 adult presenters. You choose a voice, write the line in the language you sell in, and you can use a voice you have rights to clone. There is no separate language count to memorize.

faq.q: Can I use the clip commercially?
faq.a: Yes. Finished files can be used commercially and have no watermark. The presenter is generated. Do not label the clip as a review from a real customer.

faq.q: What should I avoid when I publish?
faq.a: Do not present a generated person as a real buyer. Follow the disclosure rules of the channel you publish on, and add any price yourself after download.
